notes.title: v0.14.2 Small update.
notes.content:
OH MY, AN OBAMA MAZE UPDATE?

Change logs

 Actually fixed the tablet bug that was supposed to be fixed like 2 updates ago.
 Swapped out the tree model in the forest level for 6 new tree models
 Modified the border of the forest level to give more space around one house and fixing the stair clipping too.
 Changed how the water looks to look less like a tiny repeated texture. And also reduced speed debuff while walking through water.
 Added credits to the main menu.
 Swapped out the backend which previous was using il2cpp (Meaning it compiled to c++ then building from that) to the Mono Runtime environment which hopefully will encourage mod developers to create mod for the game with tools like BepInEx or MelonLoader


Anyways I hope to bring more updates to this game, I am still going to be slow at releasing these updates as when I started this project I was working 3 shifts a week at a grocery store with the help of a friend. Now I am working on this by myself with working full time hours currently at my new job.

If you'd like to follow the slow development project or see the dumb stuff that I create you can join the Stainton Studios Discord server here: https://discord.gg/pc2NKdRHkf

notes.title: Obama Maze v0.14.0 Holiday Update
notes.content:
Firstly you should join our terrible community on Discord!
Hello Obama Hunters!
An update is finally here!
Obama Maze v0.14.0 while not being the much wanted multiplayer update we're finally able to ship the things we've been working on since last year. 
What took so long?
Since the v0.14.0 update originally was meant to be the multiplayer update a lot of that has been worked on but the scale of it is too large to implement into this update. We've spent a lot of time on features aren't seen in this update and won't been seen for a few more updates to come. Additionally some features have been improved behind the scenes and improved for development such as the item manager which has been transformed into a way in which creating new items is so much easier than before v0.14. Additionally a language system has been added which while other languages aren't supported at the moment may easily be added into the game by editing a single file in the built version of the game.
Alright so what's in this update?
Here is a full changelog here!

 The pause menu no longer requires 5 seconds to pause.
 SNOW EVERYWHERE!!!!!
 The internal "cheat mode" detector which disables achievements if the console is used was disabled due to being extremely buggy.
 New navmesh blocks in the Forest Maze so Obama no longer can follow you into the river, into / on buildings, or into the backrooms corner.
 Redid the bear trap.
 Fixed a rare bug where the game would load over twice freezing the game if any other scenes were to play.
 Redid backend input.
 Fixed a bug where the buttons would overlap on the pause menu making you click the wrong one.
 Fixed controller's sensitivity being a lot slower than mouse.
 Temporarily removed the content manager. If you would like the trick or treat achievement you can play an older build in the betas tab.
 The bear trap now shows you the correct button if using a controller.
 Fixed a bug where you can use the tablet without using power. (Thanks InsANepErsoN and TheOg4Skin!)
 Bear trap limit is now 3.
 The level selector is redone.
 New audio mixer.
 So much more minor things that I honestly forget.


Now I'd like to conclude this with how im disappointed how little it seems like I've added since a lot of the changes just make development easier and or just isn't released publicly yet. There probably will be some hotfixes as I didn't get very much time to test this version. Hope you enjoy the update.

notes.title: Update Roadmap for Obama Maze, v0.14, v0.15, and v0.16
notes.content: First, you should join our totally awesome Discord server. News about Update v0.14 So… Yes, we're still working on this game. However, the multiplayer feature, which we understand is what everybody is wanting, may not be included in the next update like we promised. Now we wish we could've included it in the next update, but the size and scale of it makes it worthy to be its own update and not just an addition in v0.14. So what else is in v0.14? v0.14 We are dramatically improving many of the systems written two years ago, as our small team in that time has found it difficult to work with those systems, such as the systems that handles Items! Did you know? We originally were going to let the player pick up as many bear traps as they desire! However due to a limitation we only limited it to a single bear trap. We also hope to bring Steam Workshop support to this version of Obama Maze, letting players mess around with the engine, such as creating their own items, creating custom maze layouts and custom AI. We're for sure adding language support, maybe not any other ones than English at the beginning but for sure we'll slowly start translating the game with the help of our community. Now not everything listed here will get added, it’s just our goal if it’s simple enough to do within this update we do want to feature pack the current mazes and make them feel finished. What will Multiplayer be and when will it come out? We want multiplayer to include all the original maps where you can either play co-op with your friends, or chase your friends as Obama. Other game modes may be added, but multiplayer will not include any server side mod support. It will include all base game maps, and if the lobby host owns any DLC then you and your friends can play on the DLC maps which support multiplayer. Multiplayer is going to be a big update on its own. v0.16 Is expected to be the multiplayer update but maybe delayed in case we need to. What’s Update v0.15 Going to be? v0.15 is expected to be the last polish of Obama Maze and will be the last major update before multiplayer. This should be the version where all the maps are playable and you can reach the ending. If all goes well then v0.16 should be the v1.0 release of Obama Maze, finally releasing us of the curse. How can I help? Obama Maze is really rough to develop with a small team, at the moment it’s just Anthony and Logan. We could use help in translation and, if needed, development, we are unsure at the moment but get in contact with us if you’re interested. There isn't any monetary motivation because this game isn't very profitable (it’s literally free to play lmao). If you are interested in translation / development join our Discord server. Anyways, feel free to ask us any questions; we will make sure to respond.

notes.title: Obama Maze v0.13.0 Halloween Update
notes.content:
Hello Obama Hunters!
Today we're releasing the Halloween update which sounding small includes a ton of changes so lets not wait to talk about them.

The Forest Maze
The forest maze has been completely redone. Technically still in development but it has  a new layout, new features, new gameplay. Once you boot up the level you'll release that compared to its predecessor its much smaller and more compact. Rather than finding an Obamium once in, a lifetime? You'll find them almost regularly and quickly however that perk also becomes a downside when you realize Obama also gets buffed from making it smaller. Try to outmaneuver and quickly collect all 7 Obamiums and head to your trusty truck.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41686445/3a96fb7a9689837bb62e9ee1f1dd985edb105367.gif


Obama's New AI
Obama's AI has been rebuilt so that he will no longer ignore his rules and follow his instructions more carefully. Currently this rebuilt system has all the same modes as before: wander, pursuit, and flank. In the future we do plan on explaining it so that he has more modes like a disguise mode, guarding mode, and maybe more.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41686445/8fc4b2fc778406043aae6d37c11e19d5742b2fd2.gif


Halloween Event
This is a small event despite being called the Halloween update. We may update this to be better next year but for now this Halloween event with 3 different endings is what you'll find in this update. After Halloween is over you'll still be able to get the achievement by going into the manage content menu and finding Halloween level.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41686445/9b7a78402b4051e76bbd7469da76ef2ba6df9246.gif


Now time for some minor changes.

 Tutorial Maze has slightly been redone.
 Pausing now requires you to hold escape for 5 seconds. Previously you could pause instantly but all the AI, power, and other things wouldn't actually pause. Now everything actually pauses.
 Power is now a bar like sprint and both now have icons.
 DX12 and Vulkan has been made "supported" you cant actually change them in game currently and the only way to use them is to put either "-force-d3d12" or "-force-vulkan" respectively in your launch options.
 Reworked the stars. previous stars has been wiped but they should be easy enough to get back.
 Fixed some dodgy colliders
 Changed scripting backend.
 Achievements have been made for beating the tutorial, falling of the edge of the tutorial, and beating the Halloween event.
 Nerdy changes which most people may not understand which I will now list: LOD layers on maze tiles. Swapped from mono to il2cpp. Added a "launcher" doesn't actually open with Steam but in future will start the game forwarding the launch options + graphics api. Updated engine version. Updated render pipeline.


Join our Discord Server
https://discord.gg/pc2NKdRHkf

And a friendly reminder this game is not finished so please keep that in mind if you find any bugs.

notes.title: Obama Maze Early Accesss
notes.content:
The Obama Maze Early Access Release is FINALLY OUT!!!
The Early Access Release for Obama Maze is FINALLY Released. Early Access for Obama Maze may not be updated so often but it will for sure receive updates additionally this means Early Access may be buggy why? I don't have many beta testers who are active so my experience with different point of views are limited so any bugs find can be reported on the community forum or our discord linked here.

Now to explain what you'll find in this major update.

The Maps
In this Early Access release you'll find 3 playable maps (along with a scuffed tutorial) these include

Normal Maze - The quite literally "Normal Maze" is the original idea of Obama Maze, stick you, Obama, seven Obamiums, all in a brick maze and boom you've got a scuffed horror game idea.

Endless Mode - Sometimes referred as "Endless Maze" which technically is incorrect! Endless mode is basically normal mode but there is no limit to how many Obamiums you can collect as once you collect seven, six more spawn in, and repeat.

Forest Maze  - You spawn in a forest... no sense of direction... no idea how you got there.... but you've got one goal.... collect seven Obamiums of course! In the Forest Maze you are placed in the middle of a forest with a river, some inclines, a couple of houses, a church, and some fun stuff. And also you're getting chased by Obama. This maze you'll spawn with every item as the item manager isn't ready to handle picking up items from this maze (will be fixed in next update.)

Items
As some has changed and outright disappeared. 

The Flashlight - The flashlight is your typical flashlight, its a tube light emitting thing which consumes power. Wait power? yes you now have a global power usage in Early Access which automatically regenerates over time. 

The Tablet - This tablet display any videos or video games but it will show you a radar-ish type of map which will show you if there are any Obamiums located nearby but it will not show you the layout of the maze. Additionally this item drains power a lot quicker than the flashlight so don't use it too often.

The Radio - The radio / walkie talkie or really whatever you want to call it is an item which will alert you when Obama is nearby. How? you'll figure it out!!!

The Bear Trap - In normal and endless mode you'll find these littered all over the place! Pick one up and place it on the ground before Obama gets to you and he'll be stuck in place for roughly 20 seconds. (Please don't make me nerf it)

And roughly that's it! Additionally this is awkward and I have no where else to put this but you now have a sprint bar, use a little and it will regen quickly, use all of it and it will regen slowly. Anyways enjoy the Early Access and report any bugs to the Steam community forum for Obama Maze or our Obama Maze Discord Server!

notes.title: Obama Maze Demo Information.
notes.content:
I mentioned this briefly in our public Discord server but 
The Obama Maze Demo is now released!
The Obama Maze Demo is a stable in development build of Obama Maze for public beta testing. There may be bugs and if you find some please report it in our discord or the bug reports thread of our steam community. Harry and I are planning to develop additional updates to the demo so you will have more chances to play beta development builds of the game.

You (the Obama Hunter, of course) are facing one of the five faces; you will see just one of the elaborate mazes Obama has set up. You will need to navigate his maze, collecting seven Obamiums that are scattered around the place. You will be equipped in this demo with a flashlight, a compass, and a radio (we'll go on more details about these later.) Once you have collected all seven of Obama's Obamiums you will trigger the exits in the maze, there are 4 located around the map and each one will finish the level however, this maze is really big so you may have issues finding the Obamiums and or exits which if you take too long, Obama will get angrier and chase you faster. The one map you'll find in this demo is the default "Normal Maze" which is a 75x75 (2.5x scale) Brick maze in which you will be experiencing this demo in.  

The Items
The demo includes 3 of the 5 ( or 6) planned items which you'll see in the final release however, this demo gives you all the items at the start. In future updates, you may discover you only start with the flashlight and you will need to earn or find these additional items which will help you escape the maze. Now let's reveal the items in this demo!

[olist]
 The Flashlight The flashlight will help you navigate this dark maze. Without this tool, you may get lost or you may unexpectedly not see Obama until the last moment. Make sure you always use the light from time to time, as I heard a rumour that Obama is actually scared of light.
 The Compass The compass is one of your most important tools. It will help you find and locate the Obamiums around the maze with their magnetic fields. Once you activate this compass with the F key, you will see a dark red path that may lead you to an Obamium, but beware! Obama too has a magnetic field and the compass doesn't have a bias! (I hope)
 The Radio Obama doesn't only have a magnetic field... he also has a radio signal!! You can hear his radio signal if he is nearby. Pull out the radio and listen closely. If you hear static, that's okay, but if you hear a glitchy sound, well, start running!
[/olist]

That's all that I can think about to add to this announcement, if you have any questions feel free to ask anywhere! this announcement comments, steam community, our discord. Demo v2 (or Beta v0.10.0 - v0.11.x) Will be in development for a couple weeks and updates on that can be found in our discord server.
